# YVR Garage Door Springs

> Emergency garage door spring repair across Greater Vancouver. Local technicians living in each of the 16 cities we serve — typically 12 minutes from your home. One service, three flat-rate tiers, no diagnostic fee, no after-hours surcharge. Quoted price = paid price.

## What we do

We replace broken residential garage door springs (torsion and extension). One service, done right, same day in most cases. We don't sell new doors, openers, or panels — just springs and the cables that work with them.

## Service area

We serve 16 Greater Vancouver cities, with a local technician living in each one. Average drive time from call to your door: ~12 minutes (12–18 depending on city):

Vancouver, Burnaby, Richmond, Surrey, Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Port Moody, North Vancouver, West Vancouver, New Westminster, Delta, Langley, White Rock, Maple Ridge, Pitt Meadows, Tsawwassen.

## Pricing (flat-rate, all-in, plus GST/PST)

- **One Spring — $784.** Rare. Other spring stays old. Cables not replaced.
- **Two Springs (95% pick this) — $832.** 5-year parts. 2-year labour. Cables included free. 10,000-cycle springs.
- **Two High-Cycle Springs — $1,193.** 25,000-cycle springs (2.5× standard lifespan). Sealed bearings. 7-year parts. 2-year labour.

Same price 7 a.m. or 9 p.m. Tuesday or Saturday. No after-hours rate. No diagnostic fee. No surcharges on-site.

### Blog
- [Blog index](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/): all posts.
- [Heard a loud bang? Yeah, that was your spring.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/heard-a-loud-bang/): emergency-keyword response and what to do in the next 10 minutes.
- [Torsion vs. extension springs — which one is on your door?](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/torsion-vs-extension/): visual ID guide.
- [How long do garage door springs really last in Vancouver?](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/how-long-springs-last/): lifespan math, 5–10 yrs standard, 12–18 yrs high-cycle.
- [Wayne Dalton TorqueMaster — yes, we fix these.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/wayne-dalton-torquemaster/): conversion guide for TorqueMaster and TorqueMaster Plus sealed-tube systems.
- [Why cold snaps break springs — even mild Vancouver ones.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/cold-weather-springs/): ductile-to-brittle metallurgy, call-volume doubles after 0°C dips.
- [Why coastal garage door springs fail early.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/coastal-spring-corrosion/): salt-air corrosion in Tsawwassen / Richmond / White Rock / Steveston; oil-tempered + stainless cable spec. Madison Lim byline.
- [Opener won't lift the door — is it the opener or the spring?](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/opener-or-spring/): 30-second at-home diagnostic to distinguish opener failure from spring failure. Includes HowTo schema.
- [4 DIY maintenance tasks that won't kill you. And 3 that might.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/diy-garage-door-maintenance/): safe-vs-unsafe DIY guidance with explicit DANGER blocks on spring winding, cable replacement, and overhead positioning.
- [Three generations on Lulu Island.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/three-generations-lulu-island/): Madison's family-business history, 90 years of Richmond houses, why oil-tempered + stainless is the only honest spec on Lulu Island, partnership with Steveston Garage Doors.
- [Openers we'd buy. If we sold them.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/openers-we-recommend/): unbiased buyer's guide — LiftMaster Elite, Genie StealthDrive, Hörmann SupraMatic, Chamberlain. What to avoid. Refers customers to other contractors for the install.
- [Why we don't sell new garage doors.](https://yvrgaragedoorsprings.ca/blog/why-we-dont-sell-doors/): brand differentiator, business-model explainer, 3 questions to ask a contractor pushing a new door, list of trusted door-install referral partners.

## Trust

- $5M general liability insurance
- WorkSafeBC coverage on every technician
- 2-year labour warranty
- 5-year standard parts / 7-year high-cycle parts warranty
- Wrapped, marked vans; uniformed techs
